prompt:
A 2D game character sprite sheet on a PURE BLACK background (#000000). The background must be SOLID BLACK everywhere — not white, not grey, not a gradient.

LAYOUT RULES — these matter more than anything else:
- Arrange the poses in a simple grid with WIDE EMPTY BLACK GUTTERS between them, at least the width of a character between neighbours.
- Absolutely NO grid lines, NO cell borders, NO boxes, NO frames, NO dividing lines, NO ground lines of any kind.
- Absolutely NO text, NO labels, NO row titles, NO numbers, NO arrows, NO watermark.
- EVERY pose must be COMPLETE and UNCROPPED: the whole character from the tips of the horns down to the soles of the boots, with generous empty black space on all four sides. Nothing may touch, overlap, or be cut off by the image edge or by another pose.
- All poses at the SAME scale, aligned to a consistent invisible ground level.

TRUE PIXEL ART: large chunky visible square pixels on a consistent pixel grid, hard aliased edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO blur, NO soft gradients, NO glow bleed. A crisp 1-pixel dark outline around every shape. Flat color blocks, at most three shades per material. 16-bit Castlevania Symphony of the Night style.

THE CHARACTER — identical in every single pose: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god, side profile facing RIGHT. Deep brown skin (#855434 base, #4A2A1A shadow, #B07A4A highlight) on the bare forearms and hands, sleeves pushed to the elbows. A bright red #E01F26 hannya oni mask covering the ENTIRE face with glowing white eye slits and a fanged white grin, two red horns swept BACKWARD, a small cyan third eye on the forehead. A very long ponytail banded deep indigo #1E33D9 at the root through electric blue #2B6FE8 to bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tip, flowing behind him. A black tracksuit jacket with acid-green #C6F02A and cyan racing stripes down the sleeves; black hakama trousers with the same stripes, gathered into cuffs at the ankles; black tabi boots. A broad PURE WHITE sleeveless captain's haori with a torn ragged hem, hanging open. A black-scabbarded katana and wakizashi thrust through the sash at his LEFT hip.

POSES — 12 total, in reading order:
1-4: a four-frame IDLE breathing cycle, standing relaxed, swords sheathed, ponytail drifting slightly.
5-8: a four-frame RUN cycle with clearly different leg positions — front foot contact, weight down, legs passing, push off — haori and ponytail streaming behind.
9: crouching low, knees bent deep, one hand near the ground.
10: mid-turn, body twisted to near-frontal as he changes direction, hair swinging across.
11: standing alert, weight on the back foot, hand resting on the katana hilt.
12: walking slowly, one foot forward, haori settling.
